about:
Off The Line Performance operates from Des Moines, Iowa, serving the automotive aftermarket with a focus on Toyota and Subaru performance platforms. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or founder names.

The business stocks and sells a range of aftermarket performance parts, including its own OTL Performance line—such as billet aluminum pitch stop mounts and catback tips—and brands like K&N, H&R, and Racer X Fabrication. It also offers custom ECU tuning and professional installation services for the parts it sells. An e-commerce storefront provides free shipping on most orders over $399.99, and a blog publishes technical articles on Subaru and Toyota ownership. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are provided.

Customers are primarily enthusiasts and shops building or maintaining Toyota GR Corolla, GR86, GR Supra, and Subaru WRX, STI, and BRZ models. The catalog covers intake systems, ignition components, suspension, exhaust, and drivetrain upgrades for those platforms.

The company emphasizes immediate availability for stocked items and highlights its technicians’ platform-specific experience with Toyota and Subaru engines as a reason customers choose them.
